name: Brand24
summary: Media monitoring and social listening service: collects mentions of a brand's keywords from social media, news, blogs, forums, podcasts and reviews, with AI sentiment, topics and summaries. For agents: a hosted MCP server (OAuth; 401 keyless on 2026-11-11) and a REST API (X-Api-Key, paid add-on) with a public OpenAPI 3.1 file. Mention collection runs every 12 hours on the cheapest plan, hourly on the next, realtime above.

payments.notes: Read 2026-11-11, annual billing: Individual $199, Team $299, Pro $399, Business $599 a month; Enterprise from $1499. 14-day trial. The API is an extra fee ($149); MCP is for subscribers. Payment method not read. Nothing prices a call.

agentAccess.notes: MCP at mcp.brand24.com/v1/mcp: keyless initialize 401 with RFC 9728 challenge, scope projects:read; AS offers DCR, client ID metadata documents, S256, none. The marketing page's URL (no /v1) answers 301 to the homepage. REST API keyless 401.

jobs.summary: Collects mentions from the vendor's stated 30M+ sources, classifies sentiment (positive, negative, neutral as remainder) and topics, and generates summaries and daily reports. Coverage and classification accuracy are not published. Collection delay is plan-bound: every 12h, hourly, or realtime.
